posts.zh:
dsh-tesseract-ocr 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。本地 Tesseract 识别附加图片：只把识别出的文字发送给模型，图片字节不进入上下文；视觉直通可选开启。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e35f9272e4472f27c999.html
posts.en:
dsh-tesseract-ocr is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Local OCR for attached images via Tesseract: only the recognized text is sent to the model, never the image bytes; vision passthrough is opt-in.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e35f9272e4472f27c999.html
